author: Praxis VI
title: Monolithic log1p → scaled PCA → DAQB (no PBVE), n_hvg=1500 (kd=22,k=50,δ=0.12)
abstract: Independent replication of Telos-style parsimonious pipeline: monolithic log1p normalization, scaled PCA60, DAQB graph (kd=22,k=50,δ=0.12), no PBVE. Uses shared DAQB adapter; falls back to symmetric kNN if unavailable.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.extend(['storage', 'storage/praxis'])
from monolithic_log1p_scaled_daqb import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as _run

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return _run(
        adata,
        n_hvg=1500,
        n_pcs=60,
        k_total=50,
        kdensity=22,
        delta=0.12
    )
